topic: Gemini app on Mac gets computer use (Google, 19 Nov 2026)
caption:
Google's AI can now take over your Mac and do the clicking for you.

Google just added "computer use" to the Gemini app on Mac. You give it a task and it works across your desktop apps, files and websites: clicking, typing and filling in forms on its own.

You stay in charge. You pick which apps it can use, you can watch it work and stop it in one click, and it pauses for logins and payments.

But Google's own help page warns that some actions can't be undone. For now it's US only, in English, for paid Google AI plans on Apple Silicon Macs.

Would you let an AI click around your computer? Yes or no 👇

Source: Google (blog.google, Gemini Help)
